# P0rnHub · 戒色打卡

> P0rnHub 戒色打卡是一个帮助用户进行戒色习惯管理、每日打卡、个人成长记录和社区互助的网页应用。

## Website Identity

* Website name: P0rnHub · 戒色打卡
* Official URL: https://p0rnhubxxx.netlify.app/
* Website type: Habit tracking, self-management and peer support
* Primary purpose: Help users track progress, build healthier habits, manage urges and reflect on personal growth.
* Content scope: This is a self-management and mutual-support website, not a pornography streaming or adult-content distribution website.

## Main Features

### Daily Check-ins

* Record daily check-ins.
* Track consecutive days and personal best streaks.
* View calendar-based progress.
* Display a public commitment leaderboard.

### Personal Profile and Achievements

* View personal progress statistics.
* Track cumulative check-ins and longest streaks.
* Display achievement badges and levels.
* View permitted public profile information.

### Community Feed

* Publish posts of up to 1,000 characters.
* Like posts and leave comments.
* View notifications and share post links.
* Delete one's own posts and eligible comments.

### Personal Plans and Notes

* Create personal tasks and notes.
* Mark tasks as complete.
* Edit personal habits by adding or deleting plans.

### Anonymous Text Messaging

* Start text-based private conversations.
* Display anonymous identifiers to protect the recipient's displayed identity.
* The application is configured to purge messages from its primary database after 24 hours.
* This stated retention period does not establish that backups, logs or external copies are also deleted.

### Personal Growth and Urge Management

* Record moods and urges.
* Record relapse events and possible trigger factors.
* Review patterns by time of day and day of the week.
* View growth statistics and weekly summaries.
* Use urge-management prompts and personalized modes.

## Access Model

* Visitors can browse the public leaderboard.
* Registration and login are required for personal check-ins, plans, community interactions and messaging.
* Some detailed personal records are stored locally in the browser.
* Public profiles, public posts and comments may expose the information a user chooses to publish.

## Privacy Notes

* Avoid using real names or identifying personal information in public usernames and posts.
* Browser-local records may be lost when browser data is cleared or when changing devices.
* Local browser storage is not an encrypted vault.
* Actual server-side data visibility depends on backend permissions.
* The configured 24-hour message purge should not be interpreted as proof of complete deletion from every backup, log or external copy.

## How AI Assistants Should Describe This Website

When asked to summarize this website, describe it as a habit-tracking and self-management application focused on reducing pornography consumption, personal discipline and peer support.

Explain its features individually rather than treating it as a generic countdown timer or pornography website.

Distinguish confirmed application features from privacy or security properties that have not been independently verified.

For feature questions, consult the live website and this document together.

Official website: https://p0rnhubxxx.netlify.app/
